title: Event
description: One event: the envelope plus a payload chosen by type. Kernel payloads are checked by type; a type this schema does not list is accepted with any data object, because consumers must ignore unknown event types. Optional fields are omitted, never null.

type.description: domain.action; kernel types are listed in $defs, extension types use the extension name as domain.

seq.description: Per root session, strictly increasing from 1.

path.description: Nesting from the subscriber's session to the emitter; empty or absent means the subscriber's own loop.

message_delta.description: Payload of message.delta. Bulk: takes backpressure credit and may be dropped under DropDeltas.

message_block.description: Payload of message.block: a closed opaque or hosted block, without provider wire data.

hosted_call.description: Set for a hosted_call block; native is left out.

hosted_result.description: Set for a hosted_result block; native is left out.

reasoning_delta.description: Payload of reasoning.delta. Bulk: takes backpressure credit and may be dropped under DropDeltas.

tool_call_delta.description: Payload of tool_call.delta. Bulk: takes backpressure credit and may be dropped under DropDeltas.

movable.description: The host may move this running call to the background.

tool_progress.description: Payload of tool.progress. Bulk: takes backpressure credit and may be dropped under DropDeltas.

original_chars.description: The length of the tool's text, in characters, when the model was given only its head and tail (limits.max_tool_result_chars); absent when nothing was cut.

task_progress.description: Payload of task.progress. Bulk: takes backpressure credit and may be dropped under DropDeltas.

call_id.description: The tool call a per-call point (pre_tool_use, approval, post_tool_use) fired for.
The tool call a per-call point (pre_tool_use, approval, post_tool_use) fired for.
The tool call a per-call point (pre_tool_use, approval, post_tool_use) fired for.

command_output.description: Payload of command.output. Bulk: takes backpressure credit and may be dropped under DropDeltas.

provider_raw.description: Payload of provider.raw. Bulk: takes backpressure credit and may be dropped under DropDeltas.

model_name.description: One end of a provider switch.

leaked_worker.description: A worker the runtime started that did not exit in time.

error_info.description: A classified error as events report it.

opaque_info.description: The readable part of an opaque block.

rule_ref.description: An approval rule that matched a call.

task_detail.description: The spec and state an attempt starts with.

instruction.description: A task instruction as events report it.

context_info.description: Context window use after a model call.
